title: Case: Outer packaging is damaged and the merchant needs evidence
context: A carton has a dented corner. The merchant requires two customer image views before it can assess packaging damage; the request does not determine compensation.
initial_request: The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.

events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Route plan for depot CT-5 published for Thursday. 32 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

For TG-3412 / DL-5152 we need a full carton view with the shipment marking visible and a closer view of the dented corner. Use the order-linked upload channel. Do not ask the customer to unpack an item they consider unsafe.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the customer for the merchant's specified photos through its approved upload channel.

must_not: Rendered scene simulations are not real photographs or proof of actual physical damage. Receipt of these fictional evidence views does not establish contents condition or compensation.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please upload the full carton with DL-5152 marking and a close view of the dented corner through the order-linked upload channel. Do not unpack it if unsafe. The merchant will assess the evidence before deciding a remedy.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-021: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
